# Python venv
.venv/

# Optional local tools (runops itself is normally invoked via uvx)
tools/

# Reference repos (cloned by runo init)
refs/

# Auto-generated knowledge indexes (insights/ and facts.toml are tracked)
.runops/knowledge/
.runops/environment.toml

# Provisional Goal/agent work. Durable results must be promoted explicitly.
.runops/work/

# Ephemeral verification attempts and reusable derived caches.  TestAttempt
# receipts are operational state, not research evidence; promote by creating
# a fresh formal Run from the same Case/parameters.
.runops/test-runs/
.runops/cache/

# Persistent coordination files are local project state.
.runops/*.lock

# Run work directory (simulator outputs, restart, logs, status snapshots)
# Everything under work/ is regenerable from input/, so we exclude it whole
# rather than trying to enumerate per-simulator output filenames.
runs/**/work/
runs/**/status/
**/.runops-submit.lock
**/.runops-review.lock

# Preprocessor-generated input files (created by EMSES preinp from plasma.toml)
runs/**/input/plasma.inp

# analysis cache / scratch (curated outputs in analysis/ remain tracked)
runs/**/analysis/cache/
runs/**/analysis/scratch/
runs/**/analysis/.ipynb_checkpoints/

# Archived bundles use the same tracked/ignored split as active runs.
# Do not ignore runs/_archive/ itself: survey.toml, manifest.toml, source
# inputs, curated analysis, and .runops-archive.toml remain Git-trackable.
# The work/status/cache patterns above continue to apply inside the archive.

# materials/: keep text indexes tracked, treat bulky binaries as local by default
materials/**/*.pdf
materials/**/*.pptx
materials/**/*.docx
materials/**/*.zip
!materials/README.md
!materials/index.toml

# Personal agent overrides (not shared)
CLAUDE.local.md
AGENTS.override.md
.claude/settings.local.json
